Validation against established packages

Source: vignettes/articles/validation.Rmd
validation.Rmd

Every estimator in panglm is checked against an established R package, or against a hand-coded reference when no package fits the same model. The checks live in the validation folder of the repository, one script per model family. Each script fits the same model on the same data with panglm and with the reference, then compares coefficients, standard errors, log-likelihoods, test statistics and predictions value by value.

The last full run used panglm 1.6.0 and R 4.5.1. It made 109,739 comparisons and all of them passed. Each comparison has its own tolerance, stated in the script: from 1e-12 to 1e-6 for closed-form estimators, and looser where the reference uses numerical integration, a different optimizer or the bootstrap.

validate-pooled.R Pooled Gaussian, Poisson, logit, probit, Gamma and negative binomial stats, MASS, plm, fixest, sandwich 255

validate-between.R Between estimator plm, sandwich 38
validate-twowaylogit.R Two-way fixed effects logit (conditional) survival, sandwich, brute force 85
validate-slopes.R Random intercepts and slopes (Laplace, quadrature) lme4, nlme, glmmTMB, GLMMadaptive, clubSandwich 5,748

validate-tobit.R Pooled and random effects Tobit AER, censReg, sandwich 58

validate-gmm.R Difference and system GMM plm 990

Running the suite

Clone the repository, install panglm and the reference packages, then run

Rscript validation/run-all.R

from the package root. Each script writes a CSV of its comparisons to validation/results/ and stops with an error if any comparison fails. The difference-in-differences scripts take the longest, because the reference implementations compute derivatives numerically.
